name: Kluane / Wrangell-St. Elias / Glacier Bay / Tatshenshini-Alsek
description: This vast wilderness of ice and rock spans the borders of Alaska, Yukon and British Columbia, covering an area nearly the size of South Korea. It holds the world's largest non-polar icefield, the giant Malaspina Glacier, and Mount Logan, Canada's highest peak at 5,959 metres. Grizzly bears, caribou and Dall's sheep roam its valleys and slopes.
